answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 33542 Country: India Title: We have been trying for child for last one year. Now doctor has advised me to undergo semen analysis test. Question: We have been trying for child for last one year. Now doctor has advised me to undergo semen analysis test. Is semen analysis allowed? Answer ID: 33542 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1401/854/D=1432) It is allowable for the purpose of treatment. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
